3.9-open-ui-lang-사례

갤러리 섹션 1: 컴포지션 사례 (Composition Programs)​

Case 2, Web analytics, PostHog style (web-analytics)​

설명: A date range drives every number. KPI cards with change badges, an area trend with a metric switch, source bars and a funnel from Box widths, a top-pages Table and a retention grid from @MixColor.

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Col([
  head,
  kpis,
  trend,
  Grid([sources, pages], 2, 300, 4),
  Grid([funnel, retention], 2, 300, 4)
], 4)

// 상태 변수 ($range): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$range = "30d"

// 상태 변수 ($metric): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$metric = "Visitors"

// days 정의
days = $range == "7d" ? 7 : $range == "30d" ? 30 : 90

// traffic 정의
traffic = @Each(@Range(0, days), "i", {day: @FormatDate(@AddDays(@Today(), i - days + 1), "short"), Visitors: 1700 + 380 * ((i * 7) % 5) + i * 9 + (((i + 2) % 7) < 2 ? -520 : 0), Pageviews: 4200 + 820 * ((i * 3) % 4) + i * 21 + (((i + 2) % 7) < 2 ? -1300 : 0)})

// visitors 정의
visitors = @Sum(traffic.Visitors)

// views 정의
views = @Sum(traffic.Pageviews)

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Row([
  Col([Title("Web analytics", "xl"), Caption("yoursite.com · sample data")], 1),
  Spacer(),
  SegmentedControl($range, [{value: "7d", label: "7 days"}, {value: "30d", label: "30 days"}, {value: "90d", label: "90 days"}])
], 3, null, null, true)

// 핵심 지표(KPI) 및 통계 카드
kpiRows = [
  {label: "Visitors", value: @Format(visitors, "compact", 1), change: 12.4, good: true},
  {label: "Pageviews", value: @Format(views, "compact", 1), change: 8.1, good: true},
  {label: "Session length", value: "3m 12s", change: -4.2, good: true},
  {label: "Bounce rate", value: "41%", change: -2.6, good: false}
]

// 핵심 지표(KPI) 및 통계 카드
kpis = Grid(@Each(kpiRows, "k", Card([Caption(k.label), Title(k.value, "2xl"), Badge((k.change > 0 ? "+" : "") + k.change + "%", (k.change > 0) == k.good ? "success" : "danger")], null, 4, 1)), 4, 150, 3)

// 시각화 차트
trend = Card([
  Row([
    Title("Traffic", "sm"),
    Spacer(),
    SegmentedControl($metric, ["Visitors", "Pageviews"])
  ], 2),
  Chart("area", traffic, "day", [$metric], "number", null, false, 220)
], null, 5, 3)

// 원본/파생 데이터 목록
shares = [
  {name: "Google", icon: "search", share: 41},
  {name: "Direct", icon: "mouse-pointer-click", share: 24},
  {name: "Hacker News", icon: "newspaper", share: 15},
  {name: "Twitter / X", icon: "at-sign", share: 11},
  {name: "Newsletter", icon: "mail", share: 9}
]

// 데이터 테이블 및 리스트 카드
sources = Card([
  Title("Top sources", "sm"),
  Col(@Each(shares, "s", Col([Row([Icon(s.icon, "sm", "muted"), Text(s.name, "sm"), Spacer(), Text(@Format(visitors * s.share / 100, "compact", 1), "sm", null, "medium", false, false, true)], 2), Box([Box([], null, null, null, "chart1", "full", null, (s.share / 41 * 100) + "%", 6)], null, null, null, "surface", "full", null, "100%", 6)], 1)), 3)
], null, 5, 3)

// pageRows 정의
pageRows = [
  {path: "/", share: 31, time: "0:48"},
  {path: "/pricing", share: 18, time: "1:52"},
  {path: "/blog/launch-week", share: 14, time: "4:05"},
  {path: "/docs/quickstart", share: 11, time: "3:31"},
  {path: "/signup", share: 6, time: "1:10"}
]

// 데이터 테이블 및 리스트 카드
pages = Card([
  Title("Top pages", "sm"),
  Table([
    "Page",
    "Views",
    "Avg. time"], @Each(pageRows,
    "p",
    [p.path, @Format(views * p.share / 100, "compact", 1), p.time
  ]))
], null, 5, 3)

// 원본/파생 데이터 목록
steps = [
  {step: "Visited site", rate: 100},
  {step: "Viewed pricing", rate: 38},
  {step: "Started signup", rate: 12.5},
  {step: "Activated", rate: 7.4}
]

// funnel 정의
funnel = Card([
  Title("Signup funnel", "sm"),
  Col(@Each(steps, "f", Col([Row([Text(f.step, "sm"), Spacer(), Text(@Format(visitors * f.rate / 100, "compact", 1) + " · " + f.rate + "%", "sm", "muted", null, false, false, true)], 2), Box([], null, null, null, "chart3", "sm", null, f.rate + "%", 22)], 1)), 3)
], null, 5, 3)

// 원본/파생 데이터 목록
cohorts = [
  {week: "Sep 7", users: 1840, r: [100, 41, 30, 26, 23]},
  {week: "Sep 14", users: 2015, r: [100, 44, 33, 27]},
  {week: "Sep 21", users: 1922, r: [100, 39, 29]},
  {week: "Sep 28", users: 2210, r: [100, 46]},
  {week: "Oct 5", users: 2390, r: [100]}
]

// retention 정의
retention = Card([
  Title("Weekly retention", "sm"),
  Row([
    Box([Caption("Cohort")], null, null, null, null, null, null, 64),
    Box([Row(@Each(["W0", "W1", "W2", "W3", "W4"], "w", Box([Caption(w)], null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, 1, "center")), 1)], null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, 1)
  ], 2),
  Col(@Each(cohorts, "c", Row([Box([Text(c.week, "xs", null, "medium"), Caption(@Format(c.users))], null, null, null, null, null, null, 64), Box([Row(@Each(@Range(0, 5), "i", i < @Count(c.r) ? Box([Text(c.r[i] + "%", "xs", null, "medium", false, false, true)], null, null, 1, @MixColor("#EDF5FF", "#0068BC", c.r[i] / 100), "sm", null, null, 32, 1, "center", "center") : Box([], null, null, null, "surface", "sm", null, null, 32, 1)), 1)], null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, 1)], 2)), 1)
], null, 5, 3)

Case 3, Compare two phones (compare-phones)​

설명: Images found by query, a spec Table with component cells, RadioGroup cards that change the pick below.

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Col([
  title,
  intro,
  Grid([iphone, pixel], 2, 240, 4),
  Title("Side by side", "md"),
  specs,
  Title("Which suits you?", "md"),
  picker,
  verdict
])

// 상태 변수 ($care): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$care = "Camera"

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
title = Title("iPhone 17 vs Pixel 11", "xl")

// intro 정의
intro = Text("Two flagship phones at the same price. The iPhone is the safer all-rounder; the Pixel wins on photos and AI features.")

// iphone 정의
iphone = Col([
  Box([SearchImage("iPhone 17", 1, "xl", "contain")], null, null, 4, "surface", "xl"),
  Row([Title("iPhone 17", "md"), Spacer(), Badge("From $799")], 2),
  Text([Icon("cpu", "sm"), " A19 · 6.3-inch 120 Hz"], "sm", "muted")
], 2)

// pixel 정의
pixel = Col([
  Box([SearchImage("Pixel 11", 1, "xl", "contain")], null, null, 4, "surface", "xl"),
  Row([Title("Pixel 11", "md"), Spacer(), Badge("From $799")], 2),
  Text([Icon("cpu", "sm"), " Tensor G6 · 6.3-inch 120 Hz"], "sm", "muted")
], 2)

// 원본/파생 데이터 목록
rows = [
  {f: "Main camera", a: "48 MP", b: "50 MP", win: "b"},
  {f: "Battery life", a: "Up to 30 h video", b: "Up to 31 h video", win: "b"},
  {f: "Updates", a: "About 6 years", b: "7 years", win: "b"},
  {f: "Charging", a: "40 W wired · MagSafe", b: "30 W wired · Qi2", win: "a"},
  {f: "Ecosystem", a: "iMessage, Watch, Mac", b: "Gemini, Android", win: ""}
]

// 데이터 테이블 및 리스트 카드
specs = Table([
  "",
  "iPhone 17",
  "Pixel 11"], @Each(rows,
  "r",
  [r.f, Text([r.win == "a" ? Icon("check-circle", "sm", "success") : "", " " + r.a], "sm"), Text([r.win == "b" ? Icon("check-circle", "sm", "success") : "", " " + r.b], "sm")
]))

// 사용자 입력 및 컨트롤 폼
picker = RadioGroup($care, [{value: "Camera", label: "Photos", description: "Low light, zoom, editing"}, {value: "Apps", label: "My other devices", description: "Mac, Watch, iMessage"}, {value: "Battery", label: "Battery", description: "A long day of use"}], null, "cards")

// pick 정의
pick = $care == "Apps" ? "iPhone 17" : "Pixel 11"

// 요약 및 결과 표시 카드
verdict = Card([
  Row([
    Box([SearchImage(pick, 1, "lg", "contain")], null, null, 2, "canvas", "lg", null, 64, 64),
    Col([Caption("Our pick for you"), Title(pick, "lg"), Text($care == "Camera" ? "Its 50 MP sensor and editing tools take the better low-light shots." : $care == "Apps" ? "It works best with the Apple devices you already own." : "A little more screen-on time and slower battery wear.", "sm", "muted")], 1)
  ], 4)
], "soft")

Case 4, Spanish flashcards and a quiz (flashcards)​

설명: Flashcards in a Carousel, then a quiz that keeps score with @Set and bursts a Celebration on 4 of 4.

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Col([title, intro, cards, Title("Quick quiz", "md"), quiz, Celebration($score == 4)])

// 상태 변수 ($score): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$score = 0

// 상태 변수 ($q): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$q = 0

// 상태 변수 ($picked): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$picked = ""

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
title = Title("8 Spanish words for the kitchen", "xl")

// intro 정의
intro = Text([
  Icon("hand", "sm"),
  " Tap a card to see the English, then try the quiz."
], "md", "muted")

// 원본/파생 데이터 목록
words = [
  {es: "la cuchara", en: "the spoon", emoji: "🥄"},
  {es: "el cuchillo", en: "the knife", emoji: "🔪"},
  {es: "el tenedor", en: "the fork", emoji: "🍴"},
  {es: "la sartén", en: "the frying pan", emoji: "🍳"},
  {es: "la olla", en: "the pot", emoji: "🍲"},
  {es: "el horno", en: "the oven", emoji: "🔥"},
  {es: "la nevera", en: "the fridge", emoji: "🧊"},
  {es: "el vaso", en: "the glass", emoji: "🥛"}
]

// 인터랙티브 카드 그리드
cards = Carousel(@Each(words, "w", Flashcard([Title(w.emoji, "2xl"), Title(w.es, "lg")], [Title(w.en, "md"), Caption(w.es)])), 180)

// questions 정의
questions = [
  {es: "la sartén", options: ["the pot", "the frying pan", "the oven"], answer: "the frying pan"},
  {es: "el tenedor", options: ["the fork", "the knife", "the spoon"], answer: "the fork"},
  {es: "la nevera", options: ["the glass", "the oven", "the fridge"], answer: "the fridge"},
  {es: "la olla", options: ["the pot", "the spoon", "the fork"], answer: "the pot"}
]

// current 정의
current = questions[$q]

// 인터랙티브 퀴즈 카드
quiz = $q < 4 ? Card([Row([Caption("Question " + ($q + 1) + " of 4"), Spacer(), Badge("Score " + $score, "info")], 2), Title("What is " + current.es + "?", "lg"), Row(@Each(current.options, "o", Button(o, Action([@Set($picked, o), @Set($score, o == current.answer ? $score + 1 : $score), @Set($q, $q + 1)]), "outline")), 2, null, null, true), $picked == "" ? null : Caption("Last answer: " + $picked)], null, 5, 3) : Card([Title($score == 4 ? "Perfect, 4 of 4!" : "You got " + $score + " of 4", "lg"), Text($score == 4 ? "¡Muy bien! You know your way around a Spanish kitchen." : "Flip the cards again and have another go."), Button("Try again", Action([@Reset($score, $q, $picked)]), "solid", null, null, "rotate-ccw")], "soft", 5, 3)

Case 5, New primitives (primitives)​

설명: Text with inline components, Carousel, Popover, Quote, Math, Code, RadioGroup pills, a scatter Chart, Flashcard and YouTube.

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Col([
  Title("New primitives", "lg"),
  Text([
    "Text can mix ",
    Badge("inline", "purple"),
    " components, ",
    Icon("sparkles", "sm"),
    " icons and ",
    Math("\\sqrt{2}", true),
    " math."
  ]),
  Carousel([
    SearchImage("Golden Gate Bridge", 1.4),
    SearchImage("Alcatraz Island", 1.4),
    SearchImage("Painted Ladies", 1.4),
    SearchImage("Lombard Street", 1.4)
  ], 220),
  Row([
    Text("Inflation adjusts nominal GDP"),
    Popover(Icon("info", "sm", "muted"), [Text("**Real GDP** removes price changes, so it measures output.", "sm"), Link("Read more", "https://www.bea.gov")])
  ], 2),
  Quote("Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.", "Leonardo da Vinci"),
  Math("\\bar{x} \\sim \\mathcal{N}\\left(\\mu, \\frac{\\sigma^2}{n}\\right)"),
  Code("const total = items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.price, 0)", "javascript"),
  RadioGroup($size, ["S", "M", "L", "XL"], "Size", "pills"),
  Chart("scatter", [{car: "Civic", hp: 158, mpg: 36}, {car: "Model 3", hp: 271, mpg: 132}, {car: "F-150", hp: 400, mpg: 20}, {car: "Prius", hp: 194, mpg: 57}, {car: "Mustang", hp: 480, mpg: 19}], "hp", ["mpg"]),
  Grid([
    Flashcard("Bonjour", "Hello"),
    Flashcard("Merci", "Thank you")
  ], 2, 160, 3),
  YouTube("dQw4w9WgXcQ", "A music video")
])

// 상태 변수 ($size): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$size = "M"

갤러리 섹션 2: 독립 툴 애플리케이션 사례 (Working Tools & Intelligent UI)​

Case 6, Split the bill (bill)​

설명: Add and remove people and items (@Append, @Remove); who shared what with @Update and @Toggle; tax and tip; @Allocate keeps the cents adding up; copy the split. 사용자 프롬프트: "Make a bill splitter for dinner with friends"

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Card([
  head,
  people,
  addPerson,
  Divider(),
  itemsHead,
  items,
  addItem,
  Divider(),
  rates,
  summary
], null, 5, 4)

// 상태 변수 ($mode): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$mode = "item"

// 상태 변수 ($people): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$people = ["You", "Alex", "Sam", "Jordan"]

// 상태 변수 ($items): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$items = [
  {name: "Burrata & sourdough", amount: 18, people: ["You", "Alex", "Sam", "Jordan"]},
  {name: "Mains", amount: 96, people: ["You", "Alex", "Sam", "Jordan"]},
  {name: "A bottle of red", amount: 42, people: ["You", "Alex", "Jordan"]}
]

// 상태 변수 ($name): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$name = ""

// 상태 변수 ($itemName): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$itemName = ""

// 상태 변수 ($itemAmount): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$itemAmount = null

// 상태 변수 ($tax): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$tax = 8.5

// 상태 변수 ($tip): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$tip = 20

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Row([
  Col([
    Title("The check, please", "lg"),
    Text($mode == "item" ? "Tap names on an item to say who shared it." : "Everyone pays the same share.", "sm", "muted")
  ], 1),
  Spacer(),
  SegmentedControl($mode, [{value: "item", label: "By item"}, {value: "equal", label: "Equally"}])
], 3, null, null, true)

// people 정의
people = Row(@Each($people, "p", Button(p, Action([@Set($people, @Remove($people, "", p)), @Set($items, @Each($items, "it", {name: it.name, amount: it.amount, people: @Remove(it.people, "", p)}))]), "soft", null, "sm", "x")), 2, null, null, true)

// addPerson 정의
addPerson = Row([
  Input($name, null, "text", "Add a person"),
  Button("Add", Action([@Set($people, @Append($people, $name)), @Set($items, @Each($items, "it", {name: it.name, amount: it.amount, people: @Append(it.people, $name)})), @Reset($name)]), "outline", null, null, "user-plus", $name == "" || @Includes($people, $name))
], 2)

// itemsHead 정의
itemsHead = Row([
  Title("Items", "md"),
  Spacer(),
  Text(@Format(subtotal, "currency"), "sm", "muted", "medium", false, false, true)
])

// 원본/파생 데이터 목록
items = Col(@Each($items, "it", Card([Row([Text(it.name, "sm", null, "semibold"), Spacer(), Text(@Format(it.amount, "currency"), "sm", null, "medium", false, false, true), IconButton("trash-2", @Set($items, @Remove($items, "name", it.name)), "Remove " + it.name, "ghost")], 2), $mode == "item" ? Row(@Each($people, "p", Button(p, @Set($items, @Update($items, "name", it.name, "people", @Toggle(it.people, p))), @Includes(it.people, p) ? "solid" : "outline", null, "sm", @Includes(it.people, p) ? "check" : null)), 1, null, null, true) : null], null, 3, 2)), 2)

// addItem 정의
addItem = Row([
  Input($itemName, null, "text", "Item"),
  Input($itemAmount, null, "number", "Price"),
  Button("Add item", Action([@Set($items, @Append($items, {name: $itemName, amount: $itemAmount, people: $people})), @Reset($itemName, $itemAmount)]), "outline", null, null, "plus", $itemName == "" || $itemAmount <= 0)
], 2)

// rates 정의
rates = Grid([
  Slider($tax, 0, 15, 0.5, "Tax", "%"),
  Slider($tip, 0, 30, 1, "Tip", "%")
], 2, 220, 6)

// subtotal 정의
subtotal = @Sum($items.amount)

// factor 정의
factor = 1 + ($tax + $tip) / 100

// unassigned 정의
unassigned = $mode == "equal" ? 0 : @Sum(@Each($items, "it", @Count(it.people) == 0 ? it.amount : 0))

// raw 정의
raw = @Each($people, "p", factor * ($mode == "equal" ? subtotal / @Max([@Count($people), 1]) : @Sum(@Each($items, "it", @Includes(it.people, p) ? it.amount / @Count(it.people) : 0))))

// cents 정의
cents = @Sum(raw) > 0 ? @Allocate(@Round(@Sum(raw), 2), raw) : raw

// 원본/파생 데이터 목록
shares = @Each(@Range(0, @Count($people)), "i", {name: $people[i], amount: cents[i]})

// 요약 및 결과 표시 카드
summary = Card([
  Col(@Each(shares, "s", Row([Text(s.name), Spacer(), Text(@Format(s.amount, "currency"), null, null, "semibold", false, false, true)])), 2),
  Divider(),
  Row([
    Text("Total with tax and tip", "sm", "muted"),
    Spacer(),
    Title(@Format(subtotal * factor, "currency"), "lg")
  ]),
  unassigned > 0 ? Text(@Format(unassigned, "currency") + " is not assigned to anyone yet.", "xs", "warning") : null,
  Button("Copy the split", @CopyToClipboard(@Join(@Each(shares, "s", s.name + ": " + @Format(s.amount, "currency")), "\n")), "solid", null, "sm", "copy")
], "soft", 4, 3)

Case 7, The Monty Hall problem (monty)​

설명: Pick a door: @Random inside @Set hides the car and opens a goat door. Switch or stay, and simulate 1,000 games with @Range and @Each. 사용자 프롬프트: "Explain the Monty Hall problem with an interactive game"

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Card([head, doors, status, actions, record, sim], null, 5, 4)

// 상태 변수 ($choice): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$choice = -1

// 상태 변수 ($opened): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$opened = -1

// 상태 변수 ($final): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$final = -1

// 상태 변수 ($prize): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$prize = 0

// 상태 변수 ($switched): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$switched = 0

// 상태 변수 ($switchWins): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$switchWins = 0

// 상태 변수 ($stayed): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$stayed = 0

// 상태 변수 ($stayWins): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$stayWins = 0

// 상태 변수 ($simStay): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$simStay = 0

// 상태 변수 ($simGames): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$simGames = 0

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Col([
  Title("Should you switch doors?", "lg"),
  Text("One car. Two goats. A surprisingly good reason to switch.", "sm", "muted")
], 1)

// 인터랙티브 카드 그리드
doors = Grid(@Each(@Range(0, 3), "d", Pressable([Col([Text("Door " + (d + 1), "sm", "muted", "medium"), Title(d == $opened || $final >= 0 ? (d == $prize ? "🚗" : "🐐") : "🚪", "3xl"), Text(d == $choice ? "Your pick" : d == $opened ? "Opened by the host" : "Closed", "xs", d == $choice ? "info" : "muted", "medium")], 1, "center")], $choice < 0 ? Action([@Set($choice, d), @Set($prize, @Random(0, 2, true)), @Set($opened, $prize == d ? (d + 1 + @Random(0, 1, true)) % 3 : 3 - d - $prize)]) : null, d == $choice, 5, d == $opened || $final >= 0 ? "surface" : "warning", "lg")), 3, null, 3)

// 요약 및 결과 표시 카드
status = Box([
  Title($final >= 0 ? ($final == $prize ? "You found the car!" : "A goat this time.") : $choice >= 0 ? "Door " + ($opened + 1) + " has a goat." : "Start by choosing a door.", "md"),
  Text($final >= 0 ? "Switching wins whenever your first pick was a goat: 2 out of 3 times." : $choice >= 0 ? "Your door still has a 1 in 3 chance. The other closed door has 2 in 3. Switch or stay?" : "The host knows where the car is and will open another door with a goat behind it.", "sm", "muted")
], null, 1, 4, "info", "lg")

// actions 정의
actions = Row([
  $choice >= 0 && $final < 0 ? Button("Switch doors", Action([@Set($final, 3 - $choice - $opened), @Set($switched, $switched + 1), @Set($switchWins, $switchWins + ($final == $prize ? 1 : 0))]), "solid", null, null, "shuffle") : null,
  $choice >= 0 && $final < 0 ? Button("Keep my door", Action([@Set($final, $choice), @Set($stayed, $stayed + 1), @Set($stayWins, $stayWins + ($final == $prize ? 1 : 0))]), "outline") : null,
  $final >= 0 ? Button("Play again", @Reset($choice, $opened, $final), "solid", null, null, "rotate-ccw") : null,
  Button("Simulate 1,000 games", Action([@Set($simStay, $simStay + @Count(@Filter(@Each(@Range(0, 1000), "g", @Random(0, 2, true) == @Random(0, 2, true)), "", "==", true))), @Set($simGames, $simGames + 1000)]), "ghost", null, null, "dices")
], 2, null, null, true)

// record 정의
record = $switched + $stayed > 0 ? Text("Your games: switched " + @Plural($switched, "time") + " and won " + $switchWins + "; stayed " + @Plural($stayed, "time") + " and won " + $stayWins + ".", "sm", "muted") : null

// sim 정의
sim = $simGames > 0 ? Card([Row([Title("Simulated games", "sm"), Spacer(), Caption(@Format($simGames) + " games")]), Chart("bar", [{strategy: "Stay", wins: @Percent($simStay, $simGames)}, {strategy: "Switch", wins: 100 - @Percent($simStay, $simGames)}], "strategy", ["wins"], "percent", null, false, 160)], "soft", 4, 2) : null

Case 8, Retirement savings (savings)​

설명: @Each over @Range builds the yearly balance with @Pow; four sliders drive the chart, the totals and the $1 million milestone. 사용자 프롬프트: "Help me explore how my retirement savings could grow"

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Card([
  head,
  kpis,
  chart,
  milestone,
  controls,
  Text("Assumes monthly compounding and contributions at the end of each month. Returns are not guaranteed; this is an illustration, not advice.", "xs", "muted")
], null, 5, 4)

// 상태 변수 ($initial): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$initial = 10000

// 상태 변수 ($monthly): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$monthly = 500

// 상태 변수 ($years): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$years = 30

// 상태 변수 ($rate): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$rate = 5

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Row([
  Col([
    Title("Retirement savings", "lg"),
    Text("Turn today's contributions into a picture of tomorrow.", "sm", "muted")
  ], 1),
  Spacer(),
  Button("Reset", @Reset($initial, $monthly, $years, $rate), "ghost", null, "sm", "rotate-ccw")
], 3, "start")

// 원본/파생 데이터 목록
rows = @Each(@Range(0, $years + 1), "y", {year: "Year " + y, Contributions: $initial + $monthly * 12 * y, Balance: $rate == 0 ? $initial + $monthly * 12 * y : $initial * @Pow(1 + $rate / 1200, 12 * y) + $monthly * (@Pow(1 + $rate / 1200, 12 * y) - 1) / ($rate / 1200)})

// final 정의
final = @Last(rows)

// million 정의
million = @First(@Filter(rows, "Balance", ">=", 1000000))

// 핵심 지표(KPI) 및 통계 카드
kpis = Grid([k1, k2, k3], 3, 150, 3)

// k1 정의
k1 = Card([
  Caption("Balance in " + @Plural($years, "year")),
  Title(@Format(final.Balance, "currency", 0), "xl")
], "soft", 3, 1)

// k2 정의
k2 = Card([
  Caption("You put in"),
  Title(@Format(final.Contributions, "currency", 0), "xl")
], "soft", 3, 1)

// k3 정의
k3 = Card([
  Caption("Growth"),
  Title(@Format(final.Balance - final.Contributions, "currency", 0), "xl", "success")
], "soft", 3, 1)

// 시각화 차트
chart = Chart("area", rows, "year", ["Contributions", "Balance"], "currency")

// milestone 정의
milestone = Row([
  Icon(million == null ? "hourglass" : "party-popper", "sm", million == null ? "muted" : "success"),
  Text(million == null ? "At this pace the balance stays under $1 million." : "You pass **$1 million** in " + million.year + ", " + @Format(@Percent(million.Balance - million.Contributions, million.Balance), "percent", 0) + " of it from growth.", "sm")
], 2)

// controls 정의
controls = Grid([
  Slider($initial, 0, 200000, 1000, "Starting balance", "$"),
  Slider($monthly, 0, 5000, 50, "Monthly contribution", "$"),
  Slider($years, 1, 50, 1, "Years", " yrs"),
  Slider($rate, 0, 12, 0.5, "Annual return", "%")
], 2, 240, 6)

Case 9, GDP, explained (gdp-explained)​

설명: Four sliders; the bar and legend come from one parts list with @Each; negative net exports explain themselves; a knowledge check. 사용자 프롬프트: "How does GDP work? Let me explore an economy"

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Card([
  head,
  Caption("Total output"),
  total,
  bar,
  legend,
  note,
  sliders,
  Row([
    Button("Reset economy", @Reset($c, $i, $g, $x), "ghost", null, "sm", "rotate-ccw"),
    Spacer(),
    Badge("GDP = C + I + G + (X − M)", "purple")
  ], 2, null, null, true),
  Text("GDP counts the value of final goods and services produced within a country. Imports are subtracted because they were produced elsewhere.", "sm", "muted"),
  quiz
], null, 5, 4)

// 상태 변수 ($c): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$c = 600

// 상태 변수 ($i): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$i = 200

// 상태 변수 ($g): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$g = 170

// 상태 변수 ($x): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$x = 30

// 상태 변수 ($answer): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$answer = ""

// gdp 정의
gdp = $c + $i + $g + $x

// parts 정의
parts = [
  {label: "Consumer spending", value: $c, color: "chart1"},
  {label: "Business investment", value: $i, color: "chart2"},
  {label: "Government spending", value: $g, color: "chart4"},
  {label: "Net exports", value: $x, color: "chart3"}
]

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Row([
  Col([
    Title("What makes up GDP?", "lg"),
    Text("An economy, in four parts.", "sm", "muted")
  ], 1),
  Spacer(),
  Badge("Illustrative economy")
], 3, "start")

// total 정의
total = Title("$" + @Format(gdp / 1000, "number", 2) + " trillion", "2xl")

// bar 정의
bar = Box(@Each(parts, "p", Box([p.value >= 80 ? Text("$" + p.value + "B", "xs", "#ffffff", "medium") : null], null, null, null, p.color, 0, null, null, "100%", @Max([p.value, 0]), "center", "center")), "row", 0.5, null, null, "md", null, "100%", 38)

// legend 정의
legend = Grid(@Each(parts, "p", Row([Box([], null, null, null, p.color, "full", null, 10, 10), Text(p.label, "sm"), Spacer(), Text((p.value < 0 ? "-$" : "$") + @Format(@Abs(p.value)) + "B", "sm", "muted", "medium", false, false, true)], 2)), 2, 220, 2)

// note 정의
note = $x < 0 ? Text("Positive contributions add up to $" + ($c + $i + $g) + "B. Net imports subtract $" + @Abs($x) + "B, leaving $" + gdp + "B of output.", "sm", "warning") : null

// 사용자 입력 및 컨트롤 폼
sliders = Grid([
  Slider($c, 0, 1200, 10, "Consumer spending, $ billions"),
  Slider($i, 0, 600, 10, "Business investment, $ billions"),
  Slider($g, 0, 500, 10, "Government spending, $ billions"),
  Slider($x, -200, 300, 10, "Net exports, $ billions")
], 2, 240, 6)

// 인터랙티브 퀴즈 카드
quiz = Card([
  RadioGroup($answer, [{value: "a", label: "Real GDP increases by 10%"}, {value: "b", label: "Nominal GDP rises; real GDP is unchanged"}, {value: "c", label: "Both measures stay the same"}], "The same goods cost 10% more this year. What changes?"),
  $answer == "" ? null : Text(($answer == "b" ? "**Correct.** " : "**Not quite.** ") + "Real GDP adjusts for price changes, so higher prices alone raise nominal GDP but not real output.", "sm")
], "soft", 4, 2)

Case 10, Central limit theorem (clt)​

설명: Draw samples with @Random inside @Set; @Histogram and @Stats show the means narrowing like 1/√n for three populations. 사용자 프롬프트: "Help me understand the central limit theorem intuitively"

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Card([
  head,
  SegmentedControl($dist, ["Skewed", "Uniform", "Bimodal"]),
  Grid([popCard, meanCard], 2, 260, 4),
  Slider($n, 1, 50, 1, "Values per sample"),
  buttons,
  stats,
  Text("As the sample size grows, the averages of samples pile up in a bell shape around the population mean, even when the population itself is skewed.", "sm", "muted"),
  quiz
], null, 5, 4)

// 상태 변수 ($dist): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$dist = "Skewed"

// 상태 변수 ($n): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$n = 5

// 상태 변수 ($means): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$means = []

// 상태 변수 ($answer): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$answer = ""

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Col([
  Title("The central limit theorem", "lg"),
  Text("Different populations. The same bell-shaped pattern.", "sm", "muted")
], 1)

// pop 정의
pop = @Each(@Range(0.0025, 1, 0.005), "u", $dist == "Skewed" ? @Pow(u, 3) : $dist == "Uniform" ? u : (u < 0.5 ? 0.05 + 0.4 * u : 0.55 + 0.4 * u))

// current 정의
current = @Filter(@Filter($means, "dist", "==", $dist), "n", "==", $n).mean

// draw 정의
draw = @Each(@Range(0, 100), "s", {dist: $dist, n: $n, mean: @Avg(@Each(@Each(@Range(0, $n), "k", @Random(0, 1)), "u", $dist == "Skewed" ? @Pow(u, 3) : $dist == "Uniform" ? u : (u < 0.5 ? 0.05 + 0.4 * u : 0.55 + 0.4 * u)))})

// popCard 정의
popCard = Col([
  Title("Population", "sm"),
  Caption("The values we draw from"),
  Chart("bar", @Histogram(pop, 20, 0, 1), "key", ["value"], null, null, false, 150)
], 1)

// meanCard 정의
meanCard = Col([
  Title("Sample means", "sm"),
  Caption("The average of each sample of " + $n),
  @Count(current) == 0 ? Box([Text("Draw samples to see the pattern", "sm", "muted")], null, null, 6, "surface", "lg", true, "100%", 150, null, "center", "center") : Chart("bar", @Histogram(current, 20, 0, 1), "key", ["value"], null, null, false, 150)
], 1)

// buttons 정의
buttons = Row([
  Button("Draw 100 samples", @Set($means, @Take(@Concat($means, draw), -6000)), "solid", null, null, "dices"),
  Button("Draw 500", Action([@Set($means, @Take(@Concat($means, draw), -6000)), @Set($means, @Take(@Concat($means, draw), -6000)), @Set($means, @Take(@Concat($means, draw), -6000)), @Set($means, @Take(@Concat($means, draw), -6000)), @Set($means, @Take(@Concat($means, draw), -6000))]), "outline"),
  Button("Reset", @Reset($means), "ghost", null, null, "rotate-ccw")
], 2, null, null, true)

// 핵심 지표(KPI) 및 통계 카드
stats = Grid([s1, s2, s3], 3, 140, 3)

// s1 정의
s1 = Card([Caption("Samples"), Title(@Format(@Count(current)), "xl")], "soft", 3, 1)

// s2 정의
s2 = Card([
  Caption("Mean of the means"),
  Title(@Count(current) == 0 ? "-" : @Format(@Stats(current).mean, "number", 3), "xl"),
  Caption("Population: " + @Format(@Stats(pop).mean, "number", 3))
], "soft", 3, 1)

// s3 정의
s3 = Card([
  Caption("Spread of the means"),
  Title(@Count(current) == 0 ? "-" : @Format(@Stats(current).stdev, "number", 3), "xl"),
  Caption("Theory, σ/√n: " + @Format(@Stats(pop).stdev / @Sqrt($n), "number", 3))
], "soft", 3, 1)

// 인터랙티브 퀴즈 카드
quiz = Card([
  RadioGroup($answer, [{value: "a", label: "The population becomes normal"}, {value: "b", label: "The sample means form a narrower bell shape"}, {value: "c", label: "Every mean becomes exactly the same"}], "What changes when the sample size grows?"),
  $answer == "" ? null : Text(($answer == "b" ? "**Correct.** " : "**Not quite.** ") + "The population stays the same. The means become more normal and their spread shrinks like 1/√n.", "sm")
], "soft", 4, 2)

Case 11, A 7-speed bike (bicycle)​

설명: A gear slider drives an Svg of seven sprockets (@Each over @Range, index access), the ratio and the speed at a cadence. 사용자 프롬프트: "Break down the design of a 7-speed bike"

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Col([
  head,
  photos,
  Title("The main parts", "md"),
  parts,
  Title("How power reaches the wheel", "md"),
  flow,
  explorer,
  Title("Freewheel or cassette?", "md"),
  hubs,
  closing
])

// 상태 변수 ($gear): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$gear = 3

// 상태 변수 ($rpm): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$rpm = 80

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Col([
  Title("Inside a 7-speed bike", "xl"),
  Text("One chainring at the front, seven sprockets at the back and a derailleur that moves the chain between them. Small sprockets make each pedal stroke go further; big ones make hills easier.", "md", "muted")
], 2)

// photos 정의
photos = Grid([
  SearchImage("City bicycle", 1.3, "lg"),
  SearchImage("Derailleur", 1.3, "lg"),
  SearchImage("Bicycle shifter", 1.3, "lg")
], 3, 150, 2)

// parts 정의
parts = Table([
  "Part",
  "What it does"], [["Frame and fork", "Hold everything together, steer and set the riding position"],
  ["Crankset and pedals", "Turn leg power into rotation"],
  ["Chainring", "The single front gear, here 40 teeth"],
  ["Chain", "Carries the power to the rear wheel"],
  ["7 rear sprockets", "Seven sizes, so seven gear ratios"],
  ["Rear derailleur", "Moves the chain from sprocket to sprocket"],
  ["Shifter and cable", "Pull or release the cable to pick a gear"],
  ["Brakes, wheels and tires", "Stop, roll and grip the road"]
])

// flow 정의
flow = Card([
  Row(@Each(chain, "s", Row([Box([Text(s, "sm", null, "medium")], null, null, 2, "surface", "md"), s == "Rear wheel" ? null : Icon("arrow-right", "sm", "faint")], 1)), 1, "center", "center", true),
  Caption("The shifter pulls a cable; the derailleur guides the chain onto the sprocket you choose.")
], "soft", 3, 2)

// chain 정의
chain = ["Pedals", "Chainring", "Chain", "Rear sprocket", "Rear wheel"]

// teeth 정의
teeth = [28, 24, 21, 18, 16, 14, 12]

// tooth 정의
tooth = teeth[$gear - 1]

// ratio 정의
ratio = 40 / tooth

// speed 정의
speed = $rpm * ratio * 2.1 * 60 / 1000

// mode 정의
mode = $gear <= 2 ? "Easy, for climbing" : $gear <= 5 ? "Moderate, for cruising" : "Hard, for speed"

// explorer 정의
explorer = Card([
  exHead,
  cogs,
  Slider($gear, 1, 7, 1, "Gear", null, [{value: 1, label: "1 · Easy"}, {value: 4, label: "4"}, {value: 7, label: "7 · Fast"}]),
  stats,
  Slider($rpm, 50, 110, 5, "Pedaling cadence", " rpm"),
  Text(feel, "sm"),
  Caption("Assumes a 40-tooth chainring, a 12-28 freewheel and a 700c wheel (2.1 m around). Real bikes vary.")
], null, 4, 3)

// exHead 정의
exHead = Row([
  Col([
    Label("Explore the seven gears"),
    Title("Gear " + $gear + " of 7", "xl")
  ], 1),
  Spacer(),
  Badge(mode, $gear <= 2 ? "success" : $gear <= 5 ? "info" : "warning")
], 3, null, null, true)

// cogs 정의
cogs = Svg(@Each(@Range(0, 7), "i", G([Circle(26 + i * 45, 52, 6 + teeth[i] * 0.55, i == $gear - 1 ? "info" : "surface", i == $gear - 1 ? "info" : "faint", 2, i == $gear - 1 ? 0.85 : 1), Circle(26 + i * 45, 52, 4, "muted"), SvgText(teeth[i] + "T", 26 + i * 45, 104, 11, i == $gear - 1 ? "info" : "muted", "middle", i == $gear - 1 ? "semibold" : "normal")])), "0 0 320 112")

// 핵심 지표(KPI) 및 통계 카드
stats = Grid([s1, s2, s3], 3, 90, 2)

// s1 정의
s1 = Card([Caption("Rear sprocket"), Title(tooth + " teeth", "lg")], "soft", 3, 1)

// s2 정의
s2 = Card([
  Caption("Gear ratio"),
  Title(@Format(ratio, "number", 2) + " : 1", "lg")
], "soft", 3, 1)

// s3 정의
s3 = Card([
  Caption("Speed at " + $rpm + " rpm"),
  Title(@Format(speed, "number", 1) + " km/h", "lg")
], "soft", 3, 1)

// feel 정의
feel = "Each turn of the pedals turns the rear wheel " + @Format(ratio, "number", 2) + " times. " + ($gear <= 2 ? "Light to push, good for hills and starting from a stop." : $gear <= 5 ? "Balanced effort for flat roads and everyday riding." : "Heavy to push but fast, for descents and tailwinds.")

// hubs 정의
hubs = Col([SearchImage("Cassette (bicycle)", 2.4, "lg"), Grid([h1, h2], 2, 220, 3)], 3)

// h1 정의
h1 = Card([
  Text("Freewheel", "sm", null, "semibold"),
  Caption("The ratchet sits inside the sprocket cluster, which screws onto the hub. Common on budget and youth bikes.")
], "soft", 3, 1)

// h2 정의
h2 = Card([
  Text("Cassette", "sm", null, "semibold"),
  Caption("The sprockets slide onto a freehub that holds the ratchet. Better axle support and easy gear swaps.")
], "soft", 3, 1)

// closing 정의
closing = Text("Seven speeds keep the drivetrain simple, light and cheap to maintain: one shifter, one derailleur and no front gear changes to think about.", "sm", "muted")

Case 12, Assemble a youth bike (bike-repair)​

설명: Tap steps to tick them (@Toggle on indexes) with a progress bar; the brake type rewrites one step; the inseam sets the saddle height. 사용자 프롬프트: "Help me assemble a youth bicycle, step by step"

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Col([
  head,
  meta,
  setup,
  tools,
  Title("Assembly, step by step", "md"),
  progress,
  checklist,
  Title("Visual references", "md"),
  refs,
  fit,
  safety
])

// 상태 변수 ($done): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$done = []

// 상태 변수 ($brakes): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$brakes = "Rim"

// 상태 변수 ($inseam): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$inseam = 56

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Col([
  Title("Assemble a youth bike", "xl"),
  Text("Most youth bikes arrive about 85% built. You fit the handlebars, front wheel, pedals and saddle, then set up the brakes. Tap each step as you finish it.", "md", "muted")
], 2)

// meta 정의
meta = Row([
  Badge("45 to 90 minutes", "info"),
  Badge("Beginner friendly", "success"),
  Badge("Adult job, kid helper", "purple")
], 2, null, null, true)

// setup 정의
setup = Row([
  Label("Brake type"),
  SegmentedControl($brakes, ["Rim", "Disc", "Coaster"])
], 3, null, null, true)

// tools 정의
tools = Card([
  Label("You will need"),
  List([
    "4, 5 and 6 mm Allen keys",
    "15 mm pedal wrench",
    "Phillips screwdriver",
    "Pump with a pressure gauge",
    "Scissors for the zip ties"
  ])
], "soft", 3, 2)

// stepList 정의
stepList = [
  {title: "Unbox and check", detail: "Cut the zip ties, remove the packaging and lay the parts out: front wheel, pedals marked L and R, saddle and reflectors."},
  {title: "Fit the handlebars", detail: "Seat the stem, line the bars up with the front wheel and tighten the bolts evenly, a little at a time."},
  {title: "Install the front wheel", detail: "Seat the axle fully in the fork, then close the quick release or tighten both axle nuts. Spin it: it should run straight."},
  {title: "Attach the pedals", detail: "The right pedal threads clockwise, the left anticlockwise. Start both by hand, then snug them with the 15 mm wrench."},
  {title: "Set the saddle height", detail: "Insert the seat post at least to its minimum insertion mark, set the height below and tighten the clamp."},
  {title: brakeTitle, detail: brakeDetail},
  {title: "Inflate the tires", detail: "Pump to the pressure printed on the sidewall and check the bead sits evenly all round."},
  {title: "Final safety check", detail: "Check every bolt, fit the reflectors and the bell, and test the brakes at walking pace."}
]

// brakeTitle 정의
brakeTitle = $brakes == "Coaster" ? "Check the coaster brake" : $brakes == "Disc" ? "Center the disc brakes" : "Set up the rim brakes"

// brakeDetail 정의
brakeDetail = $brakes == "Rim" ? "Hook the cable noodle into the V-brake arms and center the pads on the rim, not the tire. The wheel should lock before the lever reaches the grip." : $brakes == "Disc" ? "Spin the wheel: the rotor should pass through the caliper without rubbing. If it rubs, loosen the caliper bolts, squeeze the brake and retighten." : "Pedal backwards: the rear wheel should lock. Make sure the brake arm is bolted to the frame strap."

// progress 정의
progress = Col([
  Row([
    Text(@Count($done) + " of " + @Count(stepList) + " steps done", "sm", "muted"),
    Spacer(),
    @Count($done) == @Count(stepList) ? Badge("Ready to ride", "success") : Button("Reset", @Reset($done), "ghost", null, "sm", "rotate-ccw")
  ], 2),
  Box([Box([], null, null, null, "chart2", "full", null, @Percent(@Count($done), @Count(stepList)) + "%", 6)], null, null, null, "border", "full", null, "100%", 6)
], 2)

// checklist 정의
checklist = Col(@Each(@Range(0, @Count(stepList)), "i", Pressable([Row([Icon(@Includes($done, i) ? "check-circle" : "circle", "md", @Includes($done, i) ? "success" : "faint"), Col([Text((i + 1) + ". " + stepList[i].title, "sm", null, "semibold", false, @Includes($done, i)), Caption(stepList[i].detail)], 1)], 3, "start")], @Set($done, @Toggle($done, i)), @Includes($done, i), 3)), 1)

// refs 정의
refs = Grid([r1, r2, r3, r4], 2, 160, 3)

// r1 정의
r1 = Col([
  SearchImage("Bicycle wheel quick release", 1.4, "lg"),
  Caption("Front wheel seated in the fork")
], 1)

// r2 정의
r2 = Col([
  SearchImage("Bicycle pedal", 1.4, "lg"),
  Caption("Pedals: right clockwise, left anticlockwise")
], 1)

// r3 정의
r3 = Col([SearchImage("V-brake", 1.4, "lg"), Caption("Brake pads meet the rim squarely")], 1)

// r4 정의
r4 = Col([
  SearchImage("Seatpost", 1.4, "lg"),
  Caption("Never above the minimum insertion mark")
], 1)

// fit 정의
fit = Card([
  Title("Saddle height", "sm"),
  Input($inseam, "Your child's inseam, in cm", "number"),
  Text($inseam > 0 ? "Start with the top of the saddle about **" + @Round($inseam - 2) + " cm** from the ground so both feet touch flat. Once your child rides confidently, raise it to about **" + @Round($inseam + 3) + " cm**, where only the balls of the feet touch." : "Measure from the floor to the crotch, in socks, with the back against a wall.", "sm")
], "soft", 4, 2)

// safety 정의
safety = Box([
  Row([
    Icon("shield-check", "md", "success"),
    Text("Before the first ride: the brakes stop the bike, both wheels are tight, the bars do not twist against the front wheel and the helmet fits snugly.", "sm")
  ], 2, "start")
], null, null, 3, "success", "lg")

Case 13, San Francisco in a day (route)​

설명: Map markers from @Each with a street route; the pace rescales the schedule (@Cumulative, @Pad); a pin or a row selects the stop. 사용자 프롬프트: "Plan a sightseeing route in San Francisco"

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Col([
  head,
  photos,
  badges,
  map,
  selected,
  Row([
    Title("Stop by stop", "md"),
    Spacer(),
    SegmentedControl($pace, ["Relaxed", "Balanced", "Packed"])
  ], 3, null, null, true),
  itinerary,
  closing
])

// 상태 변수 ($stop): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$stop = "Ferry Building"

// 상태 변수 ($pace): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$pace = "Balanced"

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Col([
  Title("San Francisco in one day", "xl"),
  Text("A scenic loop from the waterfront to the Golden Gate, with time to eat, walk and take photos. Tap a pin or a stop for details.", "md", "muted")
], 2)

// photos 정의
photos = Grid([
  SearchImage("Golden Gate Bridge", 1.4, "lg"),
  SearchImage("Painted Ladies Alamo Square", 1.4, "lg"),
  SearchImage("San Francisco cable car", 1.4, "lg")
], 3, 140, 2)

// badges 정의
badges = Row([
  Badge(@Plural(@Count(places), "stop"), "info"),
  Badge("About " + @Format(@Last(ends).mins / 60, "number", 1) + " hours", "neutral"),
  Badge("Walk, cable car and bus", "purple")
], 2, null, null, true)

// map 정의
map = Map(@Each(places, "p", MapMarker(p.name, p.lat, p.lng, p.category)), true, $stop, 340)

// factor 정의
factor = $pace == "Relaxed" ? 1.3 : $pace == "Packed" ? 0.75 : 1

// plan 정의
plan = @Each(places, "p", {name: p.name, mins: @Round(p.minutes * factor / 5) * 5 + 20})

// ends 정의
ends = @Cumulative(plan, "mins")

// starts 정의
starts = @Each(@Range(0, @Count(places)), "i", 540 + ends[i].mins - plan[i].mins)

// 원본/파생 데이터 목록
rows = @Each(@Range(0, @Count(places)), "i", {name: places[i].name, desc: places[i].desc, category: places[i].category, stay: @Round(places[i].minutes * factor / 5) * 5, time: (@Floor(starts[i] / 60) > 12 ? @Floor(starts[i] / 60) - 12 : @Floor(starts[i] / 60)) + ":" + @Pad(starts[i] % 60, 2) + (starts[i] >= 720 ? " PM" : " AM")})

// sel 정의
sel = @Find(rows, "name", $stop)

// selected 정의
selected = sel == null ? null : Card([Row([Icon("map-pin", "md", "info"), Col([Text(sel.name, "md", null, "semibold"), Caption(sel.time + " · " + sel.stay + " min · " + sel.category)], 0), Spacer(), Button("Directions", @OpenUrl("https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=" + sel.name + " San Francisco"), "outline", null, "sm", "navigation")], 3, null, null, true), Text(sel.desc, "sm")], "soft", 3, 2)

// itinerary 정의
itinerary = Col(@Each(rows, "r", Pressable([Row([Box([SearchImage(r.name + " San Francisco", 1, "md")], null, null, null, null, "md", null, 64, 64), Col([Row([Text(r.time, "sm", "info", "semibold", false, false, true), Caption(r.stay + " min")], 2), Text(r.name, "sm", null, "semibold"), Caption(r.desc)], 0)], 3)], @Set($stop, r.name), r.name == $stop, 2)), 1)

// closing 정의
closing = Col([
  Text("Times are estimates and include about 20 minutes to get to each next stop. Cable cars run every 10 minutes or so; a Muni day pass covers them and the buses.", "xs", "muted"),
  Row([Button("Plan a second day", @ToAssistant("Plan a second day in San Francisco that avoids these stops"), "outline", null, "sm", "calendar-plus")])
], 2)

// places 정의
places = [
  {name: "Ferry Building", lat: 37.7955, lng: -122.3937, category: "Food", minutes: 45, desc: "Coffee and pastries in the 1898 market hall on the bay."},
  {name: "Coit Tower", lat: 37.8024, lng: -122.4058, category: "Views", minutes: 45, desc: "Climb Telegraph Hill for Depression-era murals and a 360° view."},
  {name: "Lombard Street", lat: 37.8021, lng: -122.4187, category: "Landmarks", minutes: 30, desc: "Walk down the crooked block of brick switchbacks and hydrangeas."},
  {name: "Fisherman's Wharf", lat: 37.808, lng: -122.4177, category: "Food", minutes: 60, desc: "Sea lions at Pier 39 and clam chowder in a sourdough bowl."},
  {name: "Palace of Fine Arts", lat: 37.8029, lng: -122.4484, category: "Landmarks", minutes: 40, desc: "A Roman-style rotunda reflected in a quiet lagoon."},
  {name: "Golden Gate Bridge", lat: 37.8077, lng: -122.4752, category: "Views", minutes: 75, desc: "Walk out to the first tower for the classic view back at the city."},
  {name: "Golden Gate Park", lat: 37.7694, lng: -122.4862, category: "Parks", minutes: 60, desc: "The Japanese Tea Garden and the Conservatory of Flowers."},
  {name: "Alamo Square", lat: 37.7764, lng: -122.4346, category: "Views", minutes: 30, desc: "End with the Painted Ladies and the skyline at sunset."}
]

Case 14, Pacific Northwest road trip (roadtrip)​

설명: Nine stops on a driving route; tap a day to select its stop; the budget tier and traveler stepper recompute the totals and the chart. 사용자 프롬프트: "Plan a ten-day road trip through the Pacific Northwest"

// 최상위 루트 레이아웃: 전체 화면 구조와 주요 컴포넌트 배치
root = Col([head, photos, badges, map, Title("Day by day", "md"), days, budget, before, ask])

// 상태 변수 ($stop): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$stop = "Seattle"

// 상태 변수 ($tier): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$tier = "Mid-range"

// 상태 변수 ($travelers): 사용자 인터랙션에 따라 값이 변경되는 반응형 상태
$travelers = 2

// 헤더 영역: 제목과 설명 텍스트, 컨트롤 요소
head = Col([
  Title("Ten days in the Pacific Northwest", "xl"),
  Text("Rain forest, wild beaches, the Columbia River Gorge and a volcano, in one loop from Seattle. Tap a day to find it on the map.", "md", "muted")
], 2)

// photos 정의
photos = Grid([
  SearchImage("Mount Rainier Paradise", 1.4, "lg"),
  SearchImage("Hoh Rain Forest", 1.4, "lg"),
  SearchImage("Cannon Beach Haystack Rock", 1.4, "lg")
], 3, 140, 2)

// badges 정의
badges = Row([
  Badge("Best July to September", "info"),
  Badge("About 1,150 miles", "neutral"),
  Badge("9 nights", "purple")
], 2, null, null, true)

// map 정의
map = Map(@Each(stops, "s", MapMarker(s.name, s.lat, s.lng, s.kind)), true, $stop, 360)

// stops 정의
stops = [
  {name: "Seattle", lat: 47.6062, lng: -122.3321, kind: "City"},
  {name: "Port Angeles", lat: 48.1181, lng: -123.4307, kind: "Town"},
  {name: "Hoh Rain Forest", lat: 47.8601, lng: -123.9348, kind: "Nature"},
  {name: "Ruby Beach", lat: 47.7107, lng: -124.4152, kind: "Nature"},
  {name: "Astoria", lat: 46.1879, lng: -123.8313, kind: "Town"},
  {name: "Cannon Beach", lat: 45.8918, lng: -123.9615, kind: "Nature"},
  {name: "Portland", lat: 45.5152, lng: -122.6784, kind: "City"},
  {name: "Multnomah Falls", lat: 45.5762, lng: -122.1158, kind: "Nature"},
  {name: "Mount Rainier", lat: 46.786, lng: -121.7353, kind: "Nature"}
]

// plan 정의
plan = [
  {day: 1, title: "Seattle", place: "Seattle", drive: "Arrive", night: "Seattle", text: "Pike Place Market, the waterfront and the Space Needle at dusk."},
  {day: 2, title: "Ferry to the Olympic Peninsula", place: "Port Angeles", drive: "2.5 h with the ferry", night: "Port Angeles", text: "Take the Edmonds ferry, then drive up to Hurricane Ridge for mountain views."},
  {day: 3, title: "Hoh Rain Forest", place: "Hoh Rain Forest", drive: "2 h", night: "Forks", text: "Walk the Hall of Mosses under moss-draped maples; stop at Lake Crescent on the way."},
  {day: 4, title: "The wild coast", place: "Ruby Beach", drive: "1 h", night: "Kalaloch", text: "Sea stacks, driftwood and tide pools at Ruby Beach and Rialto Beach."},
  {day: 5, title: "South to Astoria", place: "Astoria", drive: "3.5 h", night: "Astoria", text: "Cross the Columbia at its mouth and climb the Astoria Column."},
  {day: 6, title: "Cannon Beach", place: "Cannon Beach", drive: "40 min", night: "Cannon Beach", text: "Haystack Rock at low tide, then the trail at Ecola State Park."},
  {day: 7, title: "Portland", place: "Portland", drive: "1.5 h", night: "Portland", text: "Food carts, Powell's Books and the Japanese Garden."},
  {day: 8, title: "Columbia River Gorge", place: "Multnomah Falls", drive: "1 h each way", night: "Portland", text: "Multnomah Falls and the waterfall corridor; check whether a timed permit is needed."},
  {day: 9, title: "Mount Rainier", place: "Mount Rainier", drive: "3.5 h", night: "Ashford", text: "Wildflower meadows and glacier views on the Skyline Trail at Paradise."},
  {day: 10, title: "Back to Seattle", place: "Seattle", drive: "2.5 h", night: "", text: "A last morning hike, then return the car in Seattle."}
]

// days 정의
days = Col(@Each(plan, "d", Pressable([Row([Box([Title(d.day + "", "md")], null, null, 2, d.place == $stop ? "info" : "surface", "md", null, 44, 44, null, "center", "center"), Col([Text(d.title, "sm", null, "semibold"), Caption(d.night == "" ? d.drive : d.drive + " · overnight in " + d.night), Text(d.text, "sm", "muted")], 0)], 3, "start")], @Set($stop, d.place), d.place == $stop, 2)), 1)

// tiers 정의
tiers = [
  {name: "Budget", lodging: 115, car: 45, food: 40},
  {name: "Mid-range", lodging: 190, car: 60, food: 65},
  {name: "Comfort", lodging: 320, car: 90, food: 110}
]

// t 정의
t = @Find(tiers, "name", $tier)

// rooms 정의
rooms = @Ceil($travelers / 2)

// costs 정의

  {item: "Lodging", amount: t.lodging * 9 * rooms},
  {item: "Rental car", amount: t.car * 10},
  {item: "Gas", amount: @Round(1150 / 27 * 4.6)},
  {item: "Food", amount: t.food * 10 * $travelers},
  {item: "Park pass", amount: 80},
  {item: "Ferries and extras", amount: 250}
]

// total 정의
total = @Sum(costs.amount)

// budget 정의
budget = Card([
